Te pagan al momento y el vehículo desapa: They pay you on the spot and the vehicle disappears. They give more the more it's worth and the better its condition, and less if it's stolen or if you've already sold them others of the same model. For one of yours, bought or upgraded at a repair shop, they also give back part of what you paid for upgrades. A bus, a boat or an aircraft is paid as scrap; an official or rented vehicle isn't bought. Each scrapyard buys only a few a day.
